news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.4% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. On February 17, 2026. TCI Industries Limited announces that it has closed the transaction. It has issued 3750 0% Non-Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares at a price of INR 400 per share for gross proceeds of INR 1,500,000. Bunny Investment & Finance

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.28 (vs ₹7.10 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.28 (up from ₹7.10 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹15.8m (up 65% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.84m (up ₹10.2m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 24% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was primarily driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 30% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 3% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: Non-Executive Director recently bought ₹369k worth of stock
news.body: On the 20th of November, Ashish Agarwal bought around 150 shares on-market at roughly ₹2,460 per share. This transaction amounted to less than 1% of their direct individual holding at the time of the trade. This was the largest purchase by an insider in the last 3 months. This was the only on-market transaction from insiders over the last 12 months.
